name: COEX LLC (COEX 3D)
summary: Green Bay, Wisconsin manufacturer with an unusual origin: a plastic spiral book-binding producer operating since 1996 that pivoted its PVC monofilament extrusion expertise into FDM filament in 2016. Manufactures everything in-house on 100% virgin resins, with an engineering-leaning catalog including its own CoexFlex TPE and CoexNylex nylon lines.

product_lines.name: Standard PLA / COEX Next PLA
product_lines.notes: Both are virgin NatureWorks Ingeo 4043D with colourant only; COEX Next differs solely by being blended with production-scrap regrind, not by performance.

product_lines.name: PLA Prime
product_lines.notes: Virgin NatureWorks Ingeo 3D850, a general-purpose PLA extrusion grade — a different resin SKU from the 4043D lines, not a toughened, high-flow or silk grade.

product_lines.name: PLA+SILK
product_lines.notes: PLA base plus a silk-effect gloss additive.

product_lines.name: ABS / ABS Prime
product_lines.notes: Standard and premium resin/QC tiers of the same base polymer.

product_lines.name: Flame Retardant Black ABS
product_lines.notes: Flame-retardant ABS; specific FR resin grade not disclosed.

product_lines.name: CoexFlex TPE (90A / 30D / 40D / 60D)
product_lines.notes: Broad-category placement only: COEX states these are derived from DuPont Hytrel base material, i.e. a thermoplastic co-polyester elastomer (TPC-ET) — chemically distinct from urethane-based TPU and from the SEBS-type grades behind the tpe entry.

product_lines.name: DuPont Hytrel 3D4000FL (NC010 natural, BK513 black)
product_lines.notes: Genuine DuPont Hytrel 3D4000FL resin; COEX states it is the contract manufacturer of Hytrel filament. TPC-ET copolyester elastomer, not TPU or SEBS-TPE — same caveat as CoexFlex.

product_lines.name: CoexNylex Unfilled Nylon
product_lines.notes: Natural/Black/White unfilled nylon; PA type (6 vs 12) not confirmed on the collection page.

additional_notes: "Prime" and "Next" are product-tier names within the COEX 3D brand, not separate brands. No white-labeling relationships were found in either direction, so oem_relationships is empty. Employee-owned after Todd Louthain, who joined in April 2020 as sales/marketing lead, purchased the business from the prior owners; co-owner Ashten Saeger, cited as instrumental to the company's early formation, died unexpectedly in 2017. Sells bed-adhesion products and adhesives ("NoClogger") but no evidence of build plates or print surfaces. Price tier reflects "100% virgin resins" US-manufacturer positioning; typical USD/kg was not sourced.

provenance.conflicts: None material. Price tier is positioning-based rather than derived from observed pricing.
